lines.en: - Tell me, Angja, hey, tell me, dear,

lines.cyr: каде ти е Анѓо мори, твоето момче.
lines.lat: kade ti e Anǵo mori, tvoeto momče.
lines.en: where is your boy, Angja, hey.

lines.cyr: не е дома, бегу море, е в' туѓина.
lines.lat: ne e doma, begu more, e v' tuǵina.
lines.en: is not at home, bey, hey, he is in a foreign land.
- You lie, Angja, hey, you lie, dear,

lines.cyr: само бегот Анѓо мори, не се лаже.
lines.lat: samo begot Anǵo mori, ne se laže.
lines.en: but the bey, Angja, hey, is not lied to.

lines.cyr: е в' планина, Анѓо мори, со дружина.
lines.lat: e v' planina, Anǵo mori, so družina.
lines.en: is in the mountains, Angja, hey, with a band.
